questions.question: The company, which had been facing financial difficulties for months, was finally forced to _______ its operations last week.
options: had been forced to close down
has been forced to sell off
were going to have to file for bankruptcy
questions.answer: has been forced to sell off

questions.question: I wish my brother _______ (study) more diligently, so that he might pass his exams with flying colours.
By the time I arrived at the party, _______ (eat) most of the food already.
If I _______ (win) the lottery, I would invest my winnings in several charitable causes.
It is essential that the new policy _______ (be) in place by the end of this quarter, so we can evaluate its effectiveness.
